task.title: e2e: purge zz-e2e-* debris on dev, collision-proof scratchName, fix stale package-lock (npm ci broken)
task.description:
Three e2e-infrastructure problems found during P6-127 (2026-08-12):

1. 76 leftover zz-e2e-* collections on the Neon dev branch (zz-e2e-mk-kid-*/mv-kid-* duplicates at top level) actively cause name-collision failures in collection-header-kebab.spec.ts and inflate copy-count assertions elsewhere (tree-manage :733 got 3 then 4 copies where 1 expected; undo-restore :208 got 4 then 6 where 2). Purge them (the suite has cleanup helpers; verify against the tree after).
2. scratchName's counter resets per file run, so repeat runs regenerate identical names and match debris. Add a per-run random suffix (the zz-e2e-rm-stale-toast-w32-1-lg0vg pattern already does this).
3. end2end/package-lock.json is stale: locks @playwright/test@1.44.1 while package.json wants ^1.62.1, so npm ci fails on a fresh clone (P6-127's worktree had to symlink node_modules from the main checkout). Regenerate the lockfile.

Related: WB-01KZMVA2Y1 (fixture pool), WB-01KZSTM2FA (kebab triage — likely explained by item 1).

4. (P6-128 review, 2026-08-12) Small e2e nits in collection-header-kebab.spec.ts's mid-delete race test: no waitForRequest fence proving the delete POST is in flight before goBack; cleanup deleteCollection silently no-ops on the already-deleted child (helper never checks resp.ok()); redundant Math.random() suffix atop scratchName. Fold into the same hygiene pass.
